notes.title: The Bastonnes - Update V1.2
notes.notes:
Hey fellas!
Small update for the game. We update sight with new style and dotted shapes.
We also update few minor settings.
New updates are coming in the future. We still improve the game based on your feedbacks! 

Hope you will like it.
Feel free to get in touch if want to talk about the game. If you want to get the last news, we have a Discord server and Twitter account.
You can check our second game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483950/Under_Pressure/]"Under Pressure"[/url], it's free!

notes.title: The Bastonnes - Release V1.0

Hope you will like it!

notes.title: The Bastonnes - Update v0.6.1
notes.notes:
Hello good fellas !
New minor update! We are back after a short break ;)

This update adds new game mode "Score" in BETA, you win if you earn the most points!
Be careful if you hit a member of your family, you will loose points.

We also add a new special card "Extinct". This card allows you to remove one dynamite from the table.

[b]Content:[/b]

[*]   Add - Score Mode
[*]   Add - Special Card "Extinct"
[*]   Add - French Localization
[/list]
